title: Comparing Fractions Worksheets: Like Denominators
intro: Teach fraction comparison by keeping the whole and the piece size the same.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Use matching strips with the same denominator. Compare the number of shaded pieces before introducing the comparison symbol.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

2/6 < 5/6

Ask your student

If the pieces are the same size, which fraction has more pieces?

If your student needs help

If the symbol is reversed, have the student read the entire comparison aloud.
